lake-zurich-einsiedeln-rigi-social-ride.title: Lake Zurich · Einsiedeln · Rigi Social Ride
lake-zurich-einsiedeln-rigi-social-ride.slogan: A 88 km loop out of Einsiedeln abbey stop
lake-zurich-einsiedeln-rigi-social-ride.story: Easy pace, good stops and enough scenery for mixed groups. Out of Einsiedeln and back again: 88 km, roughly 1 h 31 in the saddle. It goes by way of Sihlsee group, Rothenthurm moor road, Rigi foothill view and Zug   option. The highest point is 923 m. Rolling hill country.

sections.advice: Einsiedeln abbey stop → Sihlsee group pause is the reward section in Rothenthurm moor. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

This Rothenthurm moor road → Rigi foothill view stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Pragel and Ibergeregg Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 13 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Rigi foothill view → Zug food finish option
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 19 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.

scenicChapters.title: Pragel and Ibergeregg Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 28 km. 469 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

lake-zurich-einsiedeln-rigi-social-ride.storyWas: Easy pace, good stops and enough scenery for mixed groups.

legend-lake-tahoe-eastshore-drive.slogan: Lake Tahoe Eastshore Drive – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-lake-tahoe-eastshore-drive.story: curated scenic road. alpine lake, granite shore, mountains. From South Lake Tahoe it runs 35 km to Incline Village; allow about 38 min of riding. The highest point is about 2,250 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Tahoe Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 12 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
